scope: Private checker scratch database and expanded install-tree deletion; includes durable owner ledger and PID namespace reincarnation guards.
review: The server holds an exclusive private lock at shared-root/.owners/checker.lock throughout startup recovery and requests. Each Copies instance verifies the same lock device and inode.

A new Linux PID namespace may reclaim a recorded PID1/process-group1 owner only with known matching boot identity, a different known namespace and the exact durable exclusive checker lock. Generic and unknown scopes retain PID/group liveness fences.

Deletion still requires the exact scratch database name and matching database comment, or a direct .install child with its private nonce marker, original root/path/device/inode and matching owner token.
Registry records and their parent directory are fsynced before effects; nonce publication and directory deletion are synced before owner-record removal.

Private checker fixtures use persistent outer /tmp when the recognized tmpfs harness is active; cleanup preserves failures and active ownership, and requires the exclusive checker lock before removing a successful fixture directory.
The Mac ps fallback fixes LC_ALL=C and TZ=UTC so locale or timezone changes cannot falsely identify a still-live process or group as a reused numeric identifier.

tmpfs_ci_followup.production_shaped: Actual separate owner process without client owner credentials, corrupt-history rejection, exact owned database cleanup.

verification.portability_fix: The locale/timezone-only ps fallback and persistent checker fixture were reviewed against the final source; the configured-CI/tmpfs follow-up passed all3 IPC cases.

limitations: A kill after CREATE DATABASE but before its ownership COMMENT can leave an untagged scratch database; automatic cleanup refuses it.
A kill after durable directory adoption but before nonce publication can leave a missing-marker entry; automatic cleanup refuses it.
These instruction-boundary cases require operator reconciliation and do not permit deletion without the ownership evidence.
